args.summary:
This recording introduces Shania Belcher and her late partner, McGenji 'McKinsey' Celestin, to whom she has dedicated this audio diary. Shania is currently facing a 'nerve-wracking' period as she prepares to graduate from Texas State University in May 2026. A major theme is her struggle with her 'control freak' nature and the pressure she puts on herself to have a perfect plan for the future.

The core of the transcript is a deeply emotional tribute to McKinsey, detailing how they met, their two-year relationship, and his profound impact on her life. She describes him as a generous, multi-talented man who taught her the importance of self-confidence and living with no regrets. Notably, he was the one who encouraged her to start this podcast and bought her the necessary equipment. The diary also touches on Shania's family dynamics, specifically the death of her father and how McKinsey stepped in to help her mother, as well as the frustration she felt when family members did not take their relationship seriously.
